keyEvents.text: Goal! Midtjylland 0, Ajax 1. Tolu Arokodare (Ajax) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Oscar Gloukh with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Midtjylland 1, Ajax 1. Friday Etim (Midtjylland) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Kjell Wätjen (Midtjylland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Friday Etim (Midtjylland).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second yellow card to Kjell Wätjen (Midtjylland) for a bad foul.
Denil Castillo (Midtjylland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Midtjylland. Pedro Bravo replaces Denil Castillo.
Substitution, Midtjylland. Beni Junior replaces Cho Gue-Sung.
Substitution, Midtjylland. Julius Emefile replaces Friday Etim.
Goal! Midtjylland 1, Ajax 2. Tolu Arokodare (Ajax) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Abdellah Ouazane with a headed pass.
Goal! Midtjylland 1, Ajax 3. Owen Wijndal (Ajax) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Tolu Arokodare.
Substitution, Midtjylland. Stanley Iheanacho replaces Sofus Johannesen.
